items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: And actually, what I was supposedly doing was playing the part of -- in the prologue, of Wesley Barry.

ctx.x: Yeah, a unit of young children. And we were doing a prologue to a movie. And the movie was a Booth Tarkington story, called "School Days," which -- I guess he had made his reputation with "Penrod" and "Penrod and Simon" and those things for a movie for a child. A young man starred in the silent motion pictures by the name of Wesley Barry. [Berry]
And actually, what I was supposedly doing was playing the part of -- in the prologue, of Wesley Barry. And -- who was a frecklefaced kid, and I don't know where these thoughts came from --
